messages:

To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Cecilia Morales <cecilia.morales@kestrelbank.com>

Subject: Escalation: Kestrel Bank — VPC/on-prem audit request + pricing exception

Team,

Quick context: Kestrel is a top-target financial prospect (pilot -> prod if approved). They want a private VPC deployment in us-east with a few non-standard asks:
- Annual onsite audit access (3rd-party auditors) with the ability to access logs and a read-only audit environment for a single week per year.
- Data residency guarantee (no cross-border replication outside of us-east) with contractual penalty language for breach.
- Deployment constraint: must be able to run an air-gapped bundle for DR exercise (they may request an on-prem package later).

They are also asking for a one-time 30% onboarding discount tied to committing to a 24-month reserved Dedicated plan. Legal and security have flagged multiple items; deal desk (Rishi) asked for exec signoff on any departures from our standard audit/data clauses and anything >20% discount.

Attached: Kestrel_Audit_Request.pdf, SOW-draft-v3.docx.

Ask: I need a decision from Markus on the commercial exception (discount cap) and authorization to proceed on limited audit/access concessions so I can respond to Cecilia by EOD Friday.

Cecilia - copying you so you know who will be working this internally.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0183

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T12:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Escalation: Kestrel Bank — VPC/on-prem audit request + pricing exception

Thanks Vanessa — skimmed the request. A few clarifying items before we escalate to exec:
1) Is the 30% discount conditional on a 24-month minimum commitment or on invoice timing? If it's 24 months we can consider a stepped discount (20% Year 1, 10% Year 2).
2) On audit access: are they asking for full filesystem-level access to an on-prem replica, or scoped access to logs and a read-only replica environment? The attachment is vague.
3) Do they want the audit right to include source code review or only operational logs/config?

Operationally, our Deal Desk policy: any discount >20% requires VP signoff; any contractual audit clause that allows physical access or unrestricted auditor rights needs legal + security signoff with exec visibility.

Proposed commercial pathway (for consideration): permit up to 20% one-time onboarding discount plus a commitment schedule; accept a scoped audit clause limited to:
- annual audit with 14 days notice
- read-only access to a dedicated audit view of logs (no shell or write access)
- audits to be executed remotely where possible; onsite allowed only in exceptional, pre-approved circumstances and escorted

If Markus can approve that commercial framing and give legal authority to redline the audit language to the scoped version, we can keep the deal moving.

-Rishi
Senior Deal Desk Manager

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Escalation: Kestrel Bank — VPC/on-prem audit request + pricing exception

Vanessa / Rishi — reviewed the attachments and the proposed SOW. High level legal risk items:
- The draft audit request gives the customer "right to audit" without scope limits and requests potential access to backups and replicated environments. We should not allow unrestricted access to backups or source artifacts.
- The data residency penalty clause as drafted imposes liquidated damages without a clear remediation window; we can accept a service credit model but not open-ended penalties.
- The air-gapped/DR on-prem bundle request triggers export-control and operational support obligations we don't currently provision for standard contracts. That should be scoped into a separate professional services SOW and not baked into the platform SLA.

Redline recommendations (summary):
- Replace broad "right to audit" with scoped audit language: limited to (i) logs and configuration items, (ii) pre-agreed artifacts, (iii) audit to be performed remotely by default, onsite only with 30 days' notice and a documented access plan, limited to 1 week per year.
- Add a remediation window for any residency breach (30 days notice and cure) and cap service credits at a defined monthly cap (e.g., 10% of monthly fees for a single incident).
- Move any on-prem air-gapped delivery to a separate SOW and include additional fees + a security assessment requirement.

If execs want to accept the customer's original language, we need explicit signoff from VP Sales and the CEO because this has long-term risk to other customers and our operations.

I've attached a redline_summary.xlsx with proposed contract language and a marked-up SOW.

-Laura Bennett
Associate General Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T14:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Escalation: Kestrel Bank — VPC/on-prem audit request + pricing exception

Rishi — thanks for the framing. Short answer: I don't want to set a precedent that allows unrestricted auditor access or large undisclosed discounts. That said, Kestrel is a strategic name that unlocks other financial prospects.

My provisional commercial decision:
- Approve up to a 20% onboarding credit (applied as a one-time invoice credit) conditional on a 24-month minimum committed monthly reserved spend. No more than 20% without CEO signoff.
- We will accept a scoped audit right only: annual audit window limited to 7 calendar days; default remote execution; onsite only with 30 days' notice, escorted, limited to pre-agreed artifacts (logs, configs). No access to backups or developer source repositories.

Operational caveats for acceptance:
1) Security must produce a documented audit runbook and a supervisor to escort any onsite auditor.
2) Legal to prepare the redline that reflects the remediation window and caps on credits.
3) Product/Infra must confirm we can guarantee no cross-border replication and provide a technical note that will be attached to SOW.

If all three operational items are green-lit, give Vanessa permission to present this to Cecilia as our negotiated position.

-Markus
VP, Sales (acting approver)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Cecilia Morales <cecilia.morales@kestrelbank.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Escalation: Kestrel Bank — VPC/on-prem audit request + pricing exception

Cecilia — thanks for the thorough request and for prioritizing data protection. We're excited about the opportunity to work with Kestrel.

We can proceed with the following agreement in principle:
1) Commercial: Redwood will provide a one-time onboarding credit equal to 20% of the first invoice period when Kestrel signs a 24-month Reserved Dedicated commitment (details to be captured in the SOW).
2) Audit rights: Redwood will permit an annual audit limited to one 7-day window per 12 months. Audits will default to remote execution and are limited to logs, configurations, and pre-agreed artifacts. Onsite audits may be allowed with 30 days' notice, must be escorted by Redwood security, and may not access backups or developer source code.
3) Data residency: Redwood will commit to keeping Kestrel data in us-east and will include a technical annex describing replication controls. Any residency incident will include a 30-day remediation period and service credits limited to a pre-agreed cap.
4) On-prem/air-gap: Any air-gapped delivery or on-prem package requested for DR will be scoped and priced separately as professional services.

Next steps: Vanessa will send a revised SOW and a redlined contract reflecting the items above. Laura and Rishi will finalize the contract language and operational runbook; once done we'll route the final SOW for signature (DocuSign link to follow).

Appreciate the collaboration — looking forward to getting Kestrel onboard.

Best,
Markus Klein
VP, Sales (for deal approval)
